summaryEn: Elon Musk's company-wide meeting with Tesla employees, livestreamed on March 20, 2025: the Model Y changeover, Full Self-Driving, Optimus, energy storage — and a long open Q&A with the audience.
summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克与Tesla员工举行的全公司会议，于2025年3月20日直播：Model Y换代、完全自动驾驶、Optimus、储能，以及与现场观众进行的长时间开放问答。

segments.textEn: Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy. It's only possible to because of the incredible people here at Tesla. They are absolutely committed to the cause of sustainable energy and that is why we can do what no other company can do. We can make lower cost products that are still efficient and compelling and we can make them at scale. We're going to build them all in compact and high output factories that are easy for us to build quickly. We work together in a way that allows us to, to ask the hard questions. This is the product that will retire fossil fuels.

segments.textEn: We're not just creating products, we're creating a movement for sustainable energy for everyone.

You can see and you can feel,
